title: Yields Stall Triggering Market Jump, Bullish Bias Remains, Micron Earnings Moves And Top Trades
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: Market trading tick-for-tick with the 10-year (5.31-5.34%), now above 2007 highs.
Equal-weight S&P getting crushed while mega caps hold the index near highs.
Beaten-down names sold into quarter end tend to snap back at the start of the new quarter.
AI efficiency and new fabs will create a memory glut within 12-18 months.
Fed likely to raise again in October (pre-jobs report view).
Rising BTC dominance warns of an altcoin pullback.
